payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_projection.py::test_tasks_that_match_their_spans_in_count_but_not_time_are_unattributable stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/projection.py. The claim was "An instant in a second that two spans' floors share is still unattributable, and a ledger time still reads as UTC with the host zone set to `JST-9`. In case (j), one task's last cell attempt lies in the shared second and its sibling's predates both spans. In case (a), two tasks' last cell attempts land in the second of two spans.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_projection.py::test_a_task_is_tied_to_the_span_its_last_cell_attempt_starts_in, tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[format], and the criterion's witness did not fail.
